tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; also called Aziel at 1Ch.15.20;
Also named: a.zi.el (עֲזִיאֵל "Aziel" H5815)
§ Jaaziel = "made bold by God"
one of the Levites appointed by David to perform the musical service before the ark

strongs_1890.derivation: from H3267 (יָעַז) and H410 (אֵל); emboldened of God;
